title: 还在数拍

keys.prompt:
Make ONE precise production keyframe sheet of NINE sequential animation illustrations. EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows of 512x512 SQUARE cells, total 1536x1536; read row major. Invisible equal grid divisions, absolutely no written text, numbers, lettering, panel frames or gutters. Each cell has exactly the same fixed lens, solid opaque pure WHITE background, mild safe margins and fixed ground line. Draw the reference character(s) large, with the same recognizable face design, costume, hair and accessories across the 9 cells. Only characters requested in the story. Draw graphic chibi animation cels with clean shapes, not a close-up collage, no motion blur. Each cell must show a DIFFERENT complete acting pose. This is one story with a readable pay-off and reset, including hands, gaze and props. At small chat scale every pose reads. STORY: One silver sailor-uniform girl, one simple mechanical metronome on desk to her right, long dark swinging pointer. Eyes count time, slower blinking, nodding along turns into a doze; metronome keeps ticking as her forehead sinks onto folded arms, a startle raises her to resume counting.
NINE chronological drawings: 1) 0.0 s: Draw the silver-haired sailor-uniform girl upright at the desk, eyes tracking left; cross her forearms with both hands exposed beside opposite elbows, and place the metronome to her right with its long dark pointer tilted left. 2) 0.6 s: Draw the full scene with her chin dipping in time, eyes tracking right and eyelids lowering; keep her folded arms still and swing the pointer right. 3) 1.2 s: Draw her nodding lower through a slow, closed-eye blink; preserve both visible hands and swing the pointer left. 4) 1.8 s: Draw her reopening heavy eyelids toward the rightward pointer, shoulders drooping and chin sinking closer to her folded arms. 5) 2.4 s: Draw her eyes closing again as her forehead nearly reaches her forearms; keep both hands exposed and the pointer tilted left. 6) 3.0 s: Draw her asleep with forehead resting on the middle of her folded forearms, hair settling forward and both hands visible outside; swing the pointer right. 7) 3.6 s: Draw a sudden startle with her forehead lifting, eyes opening wide and shoulders jerking upward; keep both forearms planted and swing the pointer left. 8) 4.2 s: Draw her upright again, eyes following the rightward pointer and lips forming a small counting shape; retain the same crossed arms and visible hands. 9) 4.6 s: Draw her shoulders settling, chin slightly raised and eyes following the pointer as it travels left through center, ready to ease into the opening pose.
Continuity: Use one fixed camera and identical full-scene framing throughout the 4.8-second loop, preserving the girl, exposed hands and stationary metronome base while its pointer ticks continuously and pose nine eases into the distinct opening pose. ATTACHMENT AUTHORITY: the left subject is directly illustrated from the real Bilibili official pack Xingtong 好欸好欸 and 对对对: use her squat round silver-grey bob shape, big angular silver side-swept bang, small loop-shaped crossing slim hairpins on the viewer-right, dark plum tapered ink, broad warm red cheeks, low-set eyes with lively lash detail, dark navy sleeves and white sailor collar with powder-blue trim. Closely follow the shape and color blocks in the small original stickers. Omit their printed writing and onomatopoeia. Do not use generic idol character design. Where the reference shows no pupils for a gag, preserve that deliberate feature in the nod; ordinary open eyes of Xingtong are blue. Nailü, whenever requested, uses the taupe, green, white-flower figure at RIGHT of the guide. Do not draw the attachment collage as a new scene. Nailü has exactly ONE brown HEART-SHAPED COWLICK attached to the top of the head. Hair flowers and green bang streak match the right-side guide; absolutely NO floating green wavy symbols above her head. Her eye direction and smiles vary with the scene.
